benchmark.name: MADQA

summary.en: MADQA tests agents on answering expert questions over large collections of real PDF documents by retrieving and citing the supporting pages.
summary.zh: MADQA 评估 agent 在大量真实 PDF 文档上检索并引用相关页面、回答专家问题的能力。

task_format.en: With a BM25 search tool over a collection of 800 PDFs, the agent finds evidence and returns an extractive answer with the pages it cites.
task_format.zh: agent 在 800 份 PDF 组成的文档集上使用 BM25 检索工具，找出证据并给出带引用页码的抽取式答案。

explanation.en: Using the fixed BM25 search-agent harness, the model answers questions over a collection of PDFs; an LLM judge (Cohen's kappa 0.88 vs humans) scores accuracy on the 500-question test set.
explanation.zh: 在固定的 BM25 检索 agent harness 下，模型回答一批 PDF 文档上的问题；由 LLM judge（与人类的 Cohen kappa 为 0.88）在 500 题测试集上评分。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
